dashakTitleEnglish: Atma Dashak (The Dashak of the Self)
note: All 10 samas are fully populated and sourced. Original owi text and Marathi meaning from the ioustotra.blogspot.com 'Stotra (hymns)' blog (Prakash Ketkar); English meaning from John Norwell's 2015 translation. Every samas's owi count matches exactly between both independent sources with no gaps, duplicates, or numbering shifts, and no parser issues were flagged for this dashak. This dashak covers cleverness, the extent of desirelessness, the superior antaratma, the eternal brahman, the moving, an examination of cleverness, the below and above, the subtle jiva, the origin of the individual body, and the ultimate truth.

owis.original: अस्तिमांशांचीं शरीरें । त्यांत राहिजे जीवेश्र्वरें । नाना विकारीं विकारे । प्रविण होईजे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीर हाडामासांचें असतें पण त्यांत जीवरुपी ईश्र्वर राहतो. शरीरांत नाना प्रकारचे बदल होतात. त्यांच्याबरोबर बदलण्यांत तो कुशल होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this `all' body there is the body of bones and flesh. But within this body of the `all' and this body of the jiva, that Lord of the jiva should stay. Therefore these `many' modifications that are within this original modification `I am' should become *skilled at forgetting (forgetting everything, all the names and forms, is a skill and when this is learnt then this `I am', the original `name' and `form' will remain and when this is forgotten then, the Lord remains) *(maharaj- understand nothing is there and after some time it becomes your habit).

owis.original: घनवट पोंचट स्वभावें । विवरोन जाणिजे जीवें । व्हावें न व्हावें आघवें । जीव जाणे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दाट कोणतें व पोकळ कोणतें यांचें विवरण करुन जीव आपोआप तें बरोबर जाणतो. आपल्याला काय हवे व काय नको हें सगळें जीव जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The substantial (ie. atma) and the insubstantial (ie. `many') are on account of this spontaneous `all' (ie. when this `I am' looks out, there is the jiva and when this `I am' looks in then, the atma is recognized). If the jiva makes an investigation then, this will be understood and that jiva will come to know what the `many' things should be and what they should not be.

owis.original: येंकीं मागमागों घेणें । येकां न मागतांच देणें । प्रचीतीनें सुलक्षणें । ओळखावीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या जीवाला सारखें मागून मिळवावें लागतें तर एखाद्या जीवाला न मागतां मिळतें. चांगलीं लक्षणें अशा अनुभवानें कळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: As a jiva, one gets something after repeatedly begging but that One (ie. brahman or Lord) gets given without even asking (maharaj- when one cares for nothing then, the Self takes care). Therefore, by means of this `I am' experience, that One should be recognized.

owis.original: जीव जीवांत घालावा । आत्मा आत्म्यांत मिसळावा । राहराहों शोध घ्यावा । परांतरांचा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसर्‍याच्या जीवाशी आपला जीव एकरुप करावा. त्याच्या आत्म्यांत आपला आत्मा मिळवावा. अशारीतीनें दुसर्‍याच्या अंतःकरणांत काय आहे तें वारंवार शोधून पहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the jiva should renew its power and fortitude and penetrate its own self. Then, that atma will have the company of Its own Self (ie. jivatma becomes paramatma). Therefore you should make a continuous search of this inner space of the `all'.

owis.original: जानवें हेंवडकारें जालें । ढिलेपणें हेवड आलें । नेमस्तपणें शोभलें । दृष्टीपुढें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जानवें जर ढिलें ठेवले तर त्याचे पदर एकमेकांत अडकतात. तेंच जर नीट व्यवस्थित ठेवलें तर दिसायलासुद्धा ते छान दिसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: This thread of knowledge worn by the brahmin has become knotted on account of its looseness (ie. lack of restraint and proper vivek). But when it is disentangled by the restraint of the passions then, afterwards whatever he sees will be beautiful. For by steady and determined vivek, he will be adorned with the real `thread of knowledge'.

owis.original: तैसेंचि हें मनास मन । विवेकें जावें मिळोन । ढिलेपणें अनुमान । होत आहे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें आपलें मन दुसर्‍याच्या मनाशी मिळवून टाकावें. त्यांत चालढकल केली कीं कल्पनेस वाव मिळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, through vivek the mind of the jiva meets the mind of this `all'. But if there is no restraint, then there will only be guesswork and conjecture.

owis.original: अनुमानें अनुमान वाढतो । भिडेनें कार्यभाग नासतो । याकारणें प्रत्यये तो । आधीं पाहावा ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पनेनें कल्पना वाढत जातें. परस्परांना भीड पडल्यानें कार्याची हानी होते. त्यासाठीं प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव काय आहे तें प्रथम बघावें.
owis.englishMeaning: By guesswork, guesswork only increases. If one takes the touch of this world then, there fear (or regard) arises and this intent to just know, gets spoiled. Therefore by means of this `speech', that nirgun swarup at the source should be understood.

owis.original: दुसर्‍याचे जीवीचें कळेना । परांतर तें जाणवेना । वश्य होती लोक नाना । कोण्या प्रकारें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जोपर्यंत दुसर्‍याच्या जीवांतील कळत नाहीं.त्याच्या अंतःकरणांत काय आहे हें समजत नाहीं, तोपर्यंत लोक वश होणें कठीण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Neither the mind of the jiva nor the mind of this `all' can understand that Reality. That Reality therefore should not even know this inner space (ie. even the desire to know should be given up). Still, if the mind agrees with this world beyond then, how can there be the ways of the `many'? (Though this `all' is not known in that Reality, still it is required to first silence the restless wandering mind)

owis.original: आकल सांडून परती । लोक वश्यकर्ण करिती । अपूर्णपणें हळु पडती । ठाईं ठाईं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं लोक बेवकूफ बनून वशीकरणाच्या नादीं लागतात. पण वशीकरण अपुरें पडते. त्यामुळें ठिकठिकाणी अशा माणसांचे वजन पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But leaving aside this understanding of the `all', that One returns from this world beyond and agrees with this gross world that binds and hypnotizes. Then due to the feelings of incompleteness, that One runs from this place to that place to find happi- ness.

owis.original: जगदीश आहे जगदांतरीं । चेटकें करावी कोणावरी । जो कोणी विवेकें विवरी । तोचि श्रेष्ठ ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा संपूर्ण जगांत भरुन असल्यानें वशीकरणाचें चेटूक कोणी कोणावर करणें हा मूर्खपणा आहे. लोकांना वश करण्याचा विचार जो विेवेकानें करतों, तोंच श्रेष्ठ होय.
owis.englishMeaning: If that Lord of the world is within this inner space then, why should anyone use *sorcery? For if through vivek, that purush within this `all' investigates deeply, then there appears that most excellent, pure knowledge. *(Sorcery is mind's work; it says it is a cup and then that Lord of the world is forgotten and a cup appears before your eyes)

owis.original: श्रेष्ठ कार्ये करी श्रेष्ठ । कृत्रिम करी तो कनिष्ठ । कर्मानुसार प्राणी नष्ट । अथवा भले ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रेष्ठ माणूस सदैव श्रेष्ठ कामें करतो. कृत्रिम कामें करतो तो कनिष्ठ असतो. आपापल्या कामाप्रमाणें माणसें भलीं किंवा हलकी ठरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When the most excellent does then, the action is most excellent. But when That creates the artificial then, that atma becomes this gross body. Thus, one can either get destroyed in the prana in accordance with karma or one can be that which is the most virtuous and wise.

owis.original: राजे जाती राजपंथें । चोर जाती चोरपंथे । वेडें ठकेअल्पस्वार्थें । मूर्खपणें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राजा राजमार्गानें तर चोर चोरवाटेनें जातो. वेडीं माणसें थोड्या स्वार्थापायीं मूर्खपणानें फसतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The King goes by the King's way and the thief goes by the thief's way (ie. on account of objectification, the mind steals the things that do not belong to it and claims that they are its own). Then due to foolishness, those mad after the sense objects are deceived by their small selfishnesses.

owis.original: मूर्खास वाटे मी शाहाणा । परी तो वेडा दैन्यवाणा । नाना चातुर्याच्या खुणा । चतुर जाणे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण मोठे शहाणें आहोत असें मूर्खाला वाटते. पण तो खरा वेडा व दैन्यवाणा असतो. चतुरपणाच्या खर्‍या खुणा चतुराला कळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: A fool feels, "I am wise" but then, that purush has become miserly and mad after the world. However the wise purush knows that these `many' objects, are all my swarup.

owis.original: जो जगदांतरें मिळाला । तो जगदांतरचि जाला । अरत्रीं परत्रीं तयाला । काय उणें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगाच्या अंतरंगाशी जो मिसळतो तो तें अंतरंग स्वतः बनतो. मग इहलोकीं व परलोकीं त्याला कांहीं कमी पडत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush meets with this inner space of the world then, He becomes this inner space of the world. But tell me, what does that Reality want with either the gross world or this world beyond?

owis.original: बुद्धि देणें भगवंताचें । बुद्धिविण माणुस काचें । राज्य सांडून फुकाचे । भीक मागे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बुद्धि ही ईश्र्वराकडून माणसाला मिळालेली मोठी देणगी आहे. ज्याच्यापाशीं बुद्धि नाहीं तो कच्चा समजावा. जो आपल्या बुद्धिचा उपयोग करत नाही. तो जणूं काय राज्य टाकून भीक मागत फिरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This awakened buddhi is a gift given by God; without this buddhi, a man lacks in courage and leaves aside his kingdom and unnecessarily starts to beg. (maharaj everybody is a beggar in the world).

owis.original: जें जें जेंथें निर्माण जालें । तें तें तयास मानलें । अभिमान देऊन गोविलें । ठाईं ठाईं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ठिकाणीं ज्या गोष्टी निर्माण होतात त्या ठिकाणी लोकांना त्या पटतात. त्यांना त्याचा अभिमान वाटतो. ठिकठिकाणी अशा अभिमानानें लोक गुंतलेले असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever mula maya creates `here', that Reality believes this to be that Reality. This pride having been allowed in, then binds and entangles one at every place.

owis.original: अवघेच म्हणती आम्ही थोर । अवघेचि म्हणती आम्ही सुंदर । अवघेचि म्हणती आम्ही चतुर । भूमंडळीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें सगळेंच म्हणतात कीं, आपण थोर किंवा सुंदर किंवा चतुर आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Then due to the `many' thoughts, that One says, "We are the greatest"; due to the `many' thoughts, that One says, "We are the most beautiful"; due to the `many' thoughts, the One says, "We are the wisest in the whole world" (These qualities are the qualities of the brahman, but the jiva feels that they belong to him).

owis.original: ऐसा विचार आणितां मना । कोणीच लाहान म्हणवीना । जाणते आणिती अनुमाना । सकळ कांहीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही गोष्ट ध्यानांत आली म्हणजे पटते. कीं जगामध्यें कोणीही स्वतःला लहान म्हणवून घेत नाहीं. शहाणी माणसें हें सगळें बरोबर ओळखून असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is the condition of thoughtlessness when it is brought to the mind; therefore remaining in this `all', the small jiva should say nothing. Then by means of simply knowing, that One brings all its guesswork and conjecture and gives it away to this `all thing'.

owis.original: आपुलाल्या साभिमानें । लोक चालिले अनुमानें । परंतु हें विवेकानें । पाहिलें पाहिजे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्याला पसंत असलेल्या गोष्टीचा अभिमान बाळगून कल्पनेनें लोक जगतात. आपण विवेकानें हें समजून घेतलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to your great pride of `I am', this world has been created and it functions on conjecture. Therefore that thoughtless swarup should be understood by vivek (I do not exist).

owis.original: लटिक्याचा साभिमान घेणें । सत्य अवघेंच सोडणें । मूर्खपणाची लक्षणें । ते हे ऐसीं ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें खरें नाहीं त्याचा अभिमान धरायचा आणि जें खरें आहे त्याला सोडून द्यायचे, हीं मूर्खपणाची लक्षणें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Accepting this great pride of the false `I am', that Truth then gets thrown away due to body consciousness. Then due to this foolish attention, that thoughtless Reality becomes a fool.

owis.original: सत्याचा जो साभिमान । तो जाणावा निराभिमान । न्याये अन्याये समान । कदापि नव्हे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सत्याचा जो अभिमान असतो तो अभिमान नव्हे. तो निरभिमानच होय. न्याय व अन्याय दोन्ही एकसारखें असूंच शकत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: But if that purush has the pride of the Truth then, that should be known as pride- less. For justice and injustice can never be the same.

owis.original: न्याये म्हणिजे तो शाश्र्वत । अन्याये म्हणिजे तो अशाश्वत । बाष्कळ आणि नेमस्त। येक कैसा ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें न्यायमय असतें तें शाश्वत व जें अन्यायमय असतें तें अशाश्वत होय. बेशिस्त व शिस्तबद्ध दोन्ही सारखेंच असत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: Justice means, that Self is eternal; injustice means, that atma has become non- eternal. How can the Truth that conquers the passions, be the same as the false and licentious?

owis.original: येक उघड भाग्य भोगिती । येक तश्कर पळोन जाती । येकांची प्रगट महंती । येकांची कानकोंडी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक उघडपणें भाग्य भोगतात, तर एक चोर म्हणून पळून जातात. एक उघडपणें महंत म्हणून मिरवितो तर एक चोरुन महंती करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One enjoys unlimited good fortune and the other (ie. mind) steals and runs away. Within that purush there can be the realization of that One and the shame of the other ("I am a body").

owis.original: आचारविचारेंविण । जें जें करणें तो तो सीण । धूर्त आणि विचक्षण । तेचि शोधावे ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आचार व विचार न सांभाळता मनुष्य जें कांहीं करतो, ते वृथा श्रम होतात. म्हणून लोकसंग्रही मनुष्यानें चतुर आणि बुद्धिमान माणसें शोधून काढावित.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is neither thoughtlessness nor this action of mula maya then, that paramatma gets *weary. Therefore the sharp and alert, should search out that Reality. *(maharaj- the mind sleeps because it is tired of this world)

owis.original: उदंड बाजारी मिळाले । परी ते धूर्तेचि आळिले । धूर्तांपासीं कांहीं न चले । बाजार्‍यांचें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाजार बुणग्यांचा मोठा समुदाय केवळ एक चतुर पुरुष आपल्या ताब्यांत ठेवूं शकतो. चतुर पुरुषांशी बाजारी बुणग्यांचे कांहीं चालूं शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast paramatma has come into this market place of this world but through wisdom, He takes it under His control. Then in the charge of the wise, this `thing' does not set off to the market place.

owis.original: याकारणें मुख्य मुख्य । तयांसी करावे सख्य । येणेंकरितां असंख्य । बाजारी मिळती ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या दृष्टीनें समाजांतील जी मुख्य माणसें असतात त्यांच्याशी स्नेह जोडावा. तसें केलें तर असंख्य सामान्य लोक आपल्याला वश होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: By means of this `speech', that Supreme One should make friendship with Its own Reality. And by means of thoughtlessness, that immeasurable Self is met within this market place.

owis.original: धूर्तासि धूर्तचि आवडे । धूर्त धूर्तीच पवाडे । उगेचि हिंडती वेडे । कार्येविण ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चतुराला चतुर आवडतो. चतुराचा चतुरपणा चतुरलोकांमध्येंच कौतुकास्पद होतो. ज्यांना हे कळत नाहीं ते  वेडे लोक कांहीं काम न करतां उगीच भटकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The wise like the wise only and then, due to the enduring capacity of wisdom, the wise purush is met. But that silent and still Self, due to its desire for sense objects, wanders about without knowledge.

owis.original: धूर्तासि धूर्तपण कळलें । तेणें मनास मन मिळालें । परी हें गुप्तरुपें केलें । पाहिजे सर्वे ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका चतुराला दुसर्‍याचा चतुरपणा कळला म्हणजें दोघांचे मन जमतें. पण हें सारें गुप्तपणें केलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: The wise understand wisdom and due to this wisdom, the mind merges with this `all' mind. But this `all' should create that thoughtless swarup by means of this form of that hidden purush (the hidden Self is that thoughtless atma purush and His form is this `all'. If one understands that this world is nothing but my thoughts then, upon leaving these thoughts, this `all' will be experienced. And if one understands that, this experience is the beginning of the duality of maya then, that hidden purush who gives light to that `all' can be directly realized).

owis.original: समर्थाचें राखतां मन । तेथे येती उदड जन । जन आणि सज्जन । आर्जव करिती ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठ्या माणसाला आपलेंसे करुन घेतलें म्हणजे पुष्कळसे सामान्य लोक आकर्षित होतात. साधें लोक व सज्जन दोघे आर्जव करुं लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When the mind has the protection of the Master then, the thoughts go `there'. Then the people and the sajjana sing His praise.

owis.original: वोळखीनें साधावी । बुद्धीनें बुद्धि बोधावी । नीतिन्यायें वाट रोधावी । पाषांडाची ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ओळखीनें ओळखी वाढवावी. आपल्या बुद्धिनें लोकांच्या बुद्धीला प्रगल्भ करावें. नीतिन्यायांनी समाजघातक मतांना वाव देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' should acquire this `all' and this buddhi should enlighten the buddhi. By the way of justice and Truth, the heretical doctrine of duality should be destroyed.

owis.original: वेष धरावा बावळा । अंतरीं असाव्या नाना कळा । सगट लोकांचा जिव्हाळा । मोडूं नये ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाहेरुन साधाच वेष घालावा. परंतु अंतर्यामीं अनेक कलांनी संपन्न असावें. सार्‍या लोकांचे अंतःकरण सांभाळून असावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should continue to dress this statue of flesh and blood but, the `many' thou- ghts within this inner space should gain this `art' of knowing and then this source (prakruti/purush) of this lumped together gross world, should not be broken again.

owis.original: निस्पृह आणि नित्य नूतन । प्रत्ययाचें ब्रह्मज्ञान । प्रगट जाणता सज्जन । दुल्लभ जगीं ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अत्यंत निस्पृह, नित्य नवें, सदैव ताजें असणारें स्वानुभवाचें आत्मज्ञान ज्याच्यापाशी आहे असा प्रगटपणें समाजांत वावरणारा ज्ञानी साधु फार दुर्लभ असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Desireless and always new, such is that nirgun knowledge of brahman. The saj- jana/Saint knows this clearly, for He is that which is most difficult to acquire in the people (when you take yourself to be a body then, He is the most difficult to acquire. But if you become desireless then, He is the most easy to acquire).

owis.original: नाना जिनसपाठांतरें । निवतां सकळांचीं अंतरें । चंचळपणें तदनंतरे । सकळां ठाईं ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्यापाशीं अनेक विषयांचें पाठांतर असल्यानें तो सगळ्यांची अंतःकरणें निववितो. पण तो एका ठिकाणीं राहात नाहीं. तो सर्वत्र फिरत असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' thoughts are a store of tales and remembered objects. That One calms these `many' thoughts through understanding this inner space of the `all'. And due to this moving form (`I am everything, everywhere'), the `many' forms become this place of the `all'.

owis.original: येकं ठाईं बैसोन राहिला । तरी मग व्यापचि बुडाला । सावधपणें ज्याला त्याला । भेटि द्यावी ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो जर एकाच ठिकाणी स्थिर राहिला तर त्याचा लोकसंग्रह बुडतो. म्हणून त्यानें सर्वांना सावधपणें भेट देत असावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One is established in this `all' place then, afterwards this pervasiveness is submerged in that Reality. By remaining ever alert, that purush should meet that paramatma where witnessing even goes off.

owis.original: भेटभेटों उरी राखणें । हे चातुर्याचीं लक्षणें । मनुष्यमात्र उत्तम गुणें । समाधान पावे ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येलास पुःन पुःन भेटून त्यास मार्गांत ठेवावें. ही चतुरपणाची लक्षनें आहेत. सगळ्या माणसांना उत्तम गुणांच्या योगानें समाधान मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: If this meeting is made again and again then, it will be maintained and established. Thoughtlessness is due to this wise attention of knowledge and then, the man attains complete contentment (see V.1). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Nispruha Vyapa Lakshan (The Extent of Desirelessness)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: पृथ्वीमधें मानवी शरीरें । उदंड दाटलीं लाहान थोरें । पालटती मनोविकारें । क्षणाक्षणा ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामधें अक्षरशः असंख्य लहानमोठी माणसें आहेत. ती आपापल्या मनोविकाराप्रमाणें क्षणाक्षणाला वेगवेगळी वागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this `I am' body, there is a human being within this great elemental earth (ie. objective world). That great and vast paramatma has become a small gross jiva and because of its mental modifications, that One changes from moment to moment. (Due to objectification/imagination, that One takes Itself to be just a small body, full of confusions and concepts, within this wonder of knowledge/existence)

owis.original: जितुक्या मूर्ती तितुक्या प्रकृती । सारिख्या नस्ती आदिअंतीं । नेमचि नाहीं पाहावें किती । काये म्हणोनी ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जितक्या मूर्ति तितक्या प्रकृति. सुरवातीपासून अखेरपर्यंत माणसांचें वागणें सारखें नसतें. त्यांचा कांहीं नेम नसल्यानें माणसांच्या तर्‍हा किती व काय म्हणून सांगाव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: But wherever there is a body, there is this prakruti. And even she also does not remain the same from beginning to end (ie. only that purush is present from beginning to end. His prakruti is the moving power but this comes with wakefulness and goes with sleep. And when she forgets her nature then, there is a small jiva in the prana and the waking, dream and deep sleep states). And if there has been no determined practice then, how much can the `many' understand? (Without proper thought, vivek, one remains this imagined ever changing gross body)

owis.original: कित्येक म्लेंच होऊन गेले । कित्येक फिरंगणांत आटले । देशभाषानें रुधिले । कितीयेक ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळ लोक बाटून मुसलमान झाले. कित्येक लोक पोर्तुगीजराज्यांत नाहींसे झाले. पुष्कळ लोक देशी भाषांच्या भेदानें एकमेकांपासून दुरावले आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: That One within the `many' started speaking in a foreign language and therefore got lost (but that One is silent). That One within the `many' wandered endlessly around and around (but that One is always, everywhere). That One within the `many' has been caught up in the assurances of different states (but that One is stateless).

owis.original: मर्‍हाष्टदेश थोडा उरला । राजकारणें लोक रुधिला । अवकाश नाहीं जेवायाला । उदंड कामें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यांतल्या त्यात महाराष्ट्रामधें थोडे चैतन्य आहे. तेथें राजकारण करण्यास वाव आहे. माणसांना जेवायला वेळ नाहीं. येवढी कामें पडली आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: There are very few who employ raja-karana (ie. He is the doer of everything, for everything is He) and remain in this original state of `I am' only. But that paramatma has no need of this space even, for He does not care to enjoy the fruits of past actions (ie. paramatma does not require this `all' to be; He is One only).

owis.original: कित्येक युद्धप्रसंगी गुंतले । तेणें गुणें उन्मत्त जाले । रात्रंदिवस करुं लागले । युद्धचर्चा ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळ माणसें युद्धामध्यें गुंतली आहेत. तेंच डोक्यांत असल्यानें दिवसरात्र ती माणसें युद्धचर्चाच करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: And when that One within the `many' is entangled in the conflicts of attaining desires then, due to the gunas, He gets intoxicated and arrogant and day and night, He is caught up in rumours of conflict (ie. how to acquire this or that from another? etc.).

owis.original: उदिम्यास व्यासंग लागला । अवकाश नाहींसा जाला । अवघा पोटधंदाच लागला । निरंतर ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: व्यापारी माणसांच्यामागें त्यांचा व्यापार लागला आहे. त्यांत त्यांना फुरसत नाहीं. बाकीच्यांना त्यांचा पोटाचा धंदा सदैव मागें लागला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this perpetual activity of business and trade then, this space of `I am' cannot be created. Then that parabrahman has become the `many' things and Its business is filling its mind and belly.

owis.original: शडदर्शनें नाना मतें । पाषांडें वाढलीं बहुतें । पृथ्वीमधें जेथतेथें । उपदेसिती ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बुद्धीच्या क्षेत्रांत षड्दर्शनें, इतर अनेक मतें आणि पुष्कळ समाजघातक मतें यांची खूप वाढ झाली आहे. जगांत जिकडे पहावें तिकडे उपदेश देणेंच चाललेले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The six systems of philosophical thought are the dogmas of the `many' and this `all' has come down into a body and accepted these heretical doctrines. Then within this great element earth there are the so `many' different teachings everywhere.

owis.original: स्वार्थी आणि वैष्णवी । उरलीं सुरलीं नेलीं आघवी । ऐसी पाहातां गथागोवी । उदंड जाली ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यांतून जें लोक उरले त्यांना स्मार्तांनी व वैष्णवांनी आपापल्या संप्रदायांत ओढून घेतलें. एकंदरींत फारच गुंतागुंत झाली आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that One is a follower of shiva or a follower of vishnu and gets entangled and lead away to body consciousness. Though, if you think clearly and understand all this confusion then, there is only that vast paramatma.

owis.original: कित्येक कामनेचे भक्त । ठाइं ठाइं जाले आसक्त । युक्त अथवा अयुक्त । पाहातो कोण ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं सकाम भक्त ठिकठिकाणीं आसक्त होऊन बसलें आहेत. त्यांत योग्य काय व अयोग्य काय याचा कोणीच विचार करीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But when that One within the `many' is the devotee of passions and desires then, there are attachments everywhere. Then how can That ever understand the difference between attachment and detachment?

owis.original: या गलबल्यामधें गल्बला । कोणीं कोणीं वाढविला । त्यास देखों सकेनासा जाला । वैदिक लोक ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या सगळ्या गडबडींत कोणीकोणी आपला पंथ वाढविला. त्यांचा वैदिक लोक द्वेष करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This `speech' has become confused in all this confusion. For someone had been taught by another who was confused and so the confusion just kept growing until even veda traditionalists could not agree.

owis.original: त्याहिमधें हरिकिर्तन । तेथें वोढले कित्येक जन । प्रत्ययाचें ब्रह्मज्ञान । कोण पाहे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यांत आणखीं कांहीं लोक हरिकिर्तनाकडे ओढले जातात. प्रत्यक्ष आनुभवाचें ज्ञान आहें किंवा नाहीं याची कोणीच चौकशी करित नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: However within all this confusion there is the kirtana of hari (see 4.2; forget every- thing and `I am He, I am everywhere'/sagun worship) and due to this, the mind gets draw towards that One within the `many'. But who is there who can understand that nirgun knowledge of brahman (ie. who is prepared to die)?

owis.original: या कारणें ज्ञान दुल्लभ । पुण्यें घडे अलभ्य लाभ । विचारवंतां सुल्लभ । सकळ कांहीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या सगळ्यामुळें खरें ज्ञान दुर्लभ झालें आहे. पुण्य पदरीं असेल तरच तो अलभ्य लाभ घडतो. परंतु जो विचारवंत आहे त्याला ज्ञान सुलभ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this `speech' (ie. kirtana), there can be that pure knowledge that was most difficult to achieve (when you take yourself as a body). But only by great merit can that unattainable be attained; for this `all thing' easily takes possession of that thoughtless understanding (in the beginning one can easily slip from that attentionless thoughtless Self and return to this `I am' feeling; maharaj- it is like walking on a razor's edge; one slip and you are cut)

owis.original: विचार कळला सांगतां नये । उदंड येती अंतराये । उपाये योजितां अपाये । आडवे येती ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याला खरें ज्ञान झालें तर तें  कोणास सांगतां येत नाही. त्यामध्यें फार अडचणी येतात. उपाय करायला जावें तर अपाय आडवें येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If thoughtlessness is understood but not maintained then that vast paramatma appears as this `all'. Then this `all' that was devised as a cure becomes a harmful hindrance (ie. this bliss of `I am' becomes an obstruction for one takes it true and does not want to leave it).

owis.original: त्याहिमधें जो तिक्षण । रिकामा जाऊं नेदी क्षण । धूर्त तार्किक विचक्षण । सकळां माने ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा सगळ्या परिस्थितीमध्यें एखादा शहाणा माणूस निघतो. एक क्षण देखील तो वाया जाऊं देत नाहीं. तो चतुर, बुद्धिमान आणि तारतम्य जाणणारा असल्यानें सर्वांना पसंत पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If that purush is very sharp and keen then, He does not allow even a moment to be wasted. But only the shrewd, intelligent and alert value this `all'.

owis.original: नाना जिनस उदंड पाठ । वदों लागला धडधडाट । अव्हाटचि केली वाट । सामर्थ्यबळें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला अनेक विषयांचें ज्ञान पाठ असतें. तो बोलूं लागला कीं तें ज्ञान तो घडाघडा सांगू लागतो. आपल्या ज्ञानाच्या सामर्थ्यानें तो वाकडी वाट सरळ करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast paramatma is the support of the `many' objects. But when He starts saying this publically (ie. becomes objective) then, there is just a loud noise of intellectual knowledge and this highway of the steadfast `all' is made into a by-way.

owis.original: प्रबोधशक्तीची अनंत द्वारें । जाणे सकळांची अंतरें । निरुपणें तदनंतरें । चटक लागे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांना जागे करुन  शहाणें करण्याचे पुष्कळ मार्ग तो जाणतो. लोकांचें अंतःकरण तो ओळखतो. त्यामुळें त्याचे निरुपण ऐकल्यावर लोकांना त्याची चटक लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: First by means of this power of wakefulness that endless paramatma knows (ie. forget the thoughts and awake yourself); then afterwards, due to this inner space of `I am', there is a deep longing for that non-dual discourse.

owis.original: मतें मतांतरें सगट । प्रत्येय बोलोन करी सपाट । दंदक सांडून नीट । वेधी जना ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या अनुभवांच्या बोलांनी इतर सर्व मतें आणि मतांतरें तो जमीनदोस्त करुन टाकतो. अर्थहीन परंपरा सोडून तो लोकांना बरोबर मार्गदर्शन करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The dogmas, that have been all lumped together by the mind, are destroyed when that atma `speaks'. The traditions are all left aside when that atma is understood by your mind.

owis.original: नेमकें भेदकें वचनें । अखंड पाहे प्रसंगमानें । उदास वृत्तीच्या गुमानें । उठोन जातो ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचे बोलणें बरोबर लागूं पडणारे व संशय छेदणारें असतें. प्रसंग काय व कसा आहे हे तो नेहमी पाहातो. आपल्या वैराग्यशील वृत्तीच्या बलानें तो उठून चालता होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Through determination, discrimination and this `speech', that unbroken swarup has respect for this `all' connection and then, there arises a fondness for this vritti of dispassion (He just wants to know. He wants nothing from this world).

owis.original: प्रत्यये बोलोन उठोन गेला । चटक लागली लोकांला । नाना मार्ग सांडून त्याला । शरण येती ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वानुभवाचें ज्ञान बोलून निघून गेल्यानें लोकांना त्याची चटक लागते. मग इतर नाना प्रकारचे मार्ग सोडून लोक त्याला शरण जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: And when this world beyond longs only for that nirgun understanding then, this `speech' gets up and leaves. The ways of the `many' have been left aside and now one comes in surrender to that paramatma.

owis.original: परी तो कोठें आडळेना । कोणे स्थळीं सांपडेना । वेष पाहातां हीन दीना । सारिखा दिसे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण त्याला शोधला तर तों कोठेंच आढळत नाहीं. कोणत्याही एका जागीं सांपडत नाहीं. त्याचा वेशही अगदी हीनदीनासारखा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But there is nowhere where that paramatma can be met. He cannot be found at some place. Then you understand that, this seeing of the `all' is also an inferior attention, just like this guise of a human body (this knowledge is also completely false. It is an attention within that attentionless paramatma, beyond time, space/place and existence).

owis.original: उदंड करी गुप्तरुपें । भिकार्‍यासारिखा स्वरुपें । तेथें येककीर्तिप्रतापें । सीमा सांडिली ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वतः गुप्त राहून तो कार्य करतो. बाहेरुन दिसावाला तो भिकार्‍यासारखा दिसतो.पण त्याचे यश, त्याची कीर्ति, त्याचा प्रताप जिकडेतिकडे पसरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If that vast paramatma becomes the doer, on account of that hidden purush and His prakruti then, that completely free swarup becomes just like a beggar (ie. `I want to know, I want to be'). For when `there', beyond any quality, is let slip then, there is this limitation of `I am victorious, all-pervasive and full of splendour' (ie. qualities of this mula maya).

owis.original: ठाइं ठाइं भजन लावी । आपण तेथून चुकावी । मछरमतांची गोवी । लागोंच नेदी ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ठिकठिकाणी तो लोकांना भजनाकडे परंतु आपण तेथून गायब होतो. कोणी आपला मत्सर करील अशा गुंतागुंतींत तो अडकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then the bhajan has been established in this `place of the all', but `here' (in this `all' of mula maya), you are still present and you should be missing from `there' (brahman). Still, the envy and selfishness of entangling dogmas and opinions (ie. body consci- ousness) are not allowed to enter `here'.

owis.original: खनाळामधें जाऊन राहे । तेथें कोणीच न पाहे । सर्वत्रांची चिंता वाहे । सर्वकाळ ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो डोंगराच्या घळींत जाऊन राहातो. तेथें जाऊन त्याला कोणी भेटू शकत नाही. पण तेथें तो सर्वांची नेहमी काळजी करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if you go and stay in this hidden place (ie. then there is witnessing), still `there', there is no-one even to witness. But at that hidden place, the purush is remembering this place of the `all' and cherishes this time of the `all' (the `all' is in time and space and this `wonder' has become a hindrance; for the purush does not want to leave this `vision'; He does not want to die).

owis.original: अवघड स्थळीं कठीण लोक । तेथें राहाणें नेमक । सृष्टीमधें सकळ लोक । धुंडीत येती ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: डोंगरांत अवघड ठिकाणीं तो राहातो. तेथें त्याचे नेहमीचे वास्तव असते. तरी जगांतील लोक त्याला शोधत येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the difficult, arduous and sometimes impassable places of the gross world there is this world of mula maya. But the truly determined will stay `there'. However when there is no determination then, this world of the `all' goes searching and rumma- ging in this gross world.

owis.original: तेथें कोणाचें चालेना । अनुमात्र अनुमानेना । कट्ट घालून राजकारणा । लोक लावी ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्यासमोर कोणचे कांहीं चालत नाही. त्याची थोडीही कल्पना येत नाहीं. समूह निर्माण करुन तो लोकांना राजकारण करायला शिकवतो.
owis.englishMeaning: `There' nothing moves and there is not even a speck of guesswork. But first ardent and bold raja-karana is required to establish this world of the `all'.

owis.original: लोकीं लोक वाढविले । तेणें अमर्याद जाले । भूमंडळीं सत्ता चाले । गुप्तरुपें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समूहानें समूह निर्माण होतात. त्यामुळें मोठी संघटना तयार होते. अशा रीतीनें तो गुप्त राहून त्याची सत्ता समाजावर चालते.
owis.englishMeaning: In this gross world, the world beyond should be made to expand and this `all' world (ie. knowledge) should transgress all bounds. But still understand, this power that moves this gross creation is due to prakruti and that hidden purush (ie. still this power is the power of maya).

owis.original: ठाइं ठाइं उदंड ताबे । मनुष्यमात्र तितुकें झोंबे । चहुंकडे उदंड लांबे । परमार्थबुद्धी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ठिकठिकाणीं त्याच्या अनुयायांचे समुह असल्यानें त्याकडे लोक आकर्षिले जातात. समाजामध्यें सर्वत्र परमार्थबुद्धि पसरते.
owis.englishMeaning: When that paramatma is this power then, in every place, all mankind is gathered together (`I see myself only'). And when that vast paramatma expands in every direction then, there is that buddhi of paramarth. (That paramatma had become the `many' people and when these thoughts were all gathered together to make this one thought `I am' then, that paramatma is this `all'. And now that this understanding has come then, that paramatma can meet Its Self once more)

owis.original: उपासनेचा गजर । स्थळोस्थळीं थोर थोर । प्रत्ययानें प्राणीमात्र । सोडविले ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यामुळें जागोजागीं उपासनेचा गजर ऐकूं येऊं लागतो. अशारीतीनें आपल्या स्वानुभवाच्या सामर्थ्यानें तो लोकांना मुक्त करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this roar of His worship (ie. `I am') there is that `greatest of the great' in every place. And due to that nirgun understanding, that one in only the prana will be set free.

owis.original: ऐसे कैवाडे उदंड जाणे । तेणें लोक होती शहाणे । जेथें तेथें प्रत्येय बाणे । प्राणीमात्रासी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकसंग्रहाच्या अनेक क्लुप्त्या त्याच्यापाशीं असतात. त्याचा वापर केल्यानें लोक शहाणें होतात. प्रत्येक ठिकाणीं त्याच्या ज्ञानाचा लोकांना प्रत्यय येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to vivek that vast paramatma knows and due to this knowing, there is the world of the wise. Then due to that nirgun understanding, that one in only the prana, is accepted `here'/maya and `there'/brahman.

owis.original: ऐसी कीर्ति करुन जावें । तरीच संसारास यावें । दास म्हणे हें स्वभावें । संकेतें बोलिलें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी कीर्ति संपादून जाण्यांतच संसारांत येण्याचें सार्थक आहे. रामदासस्वामी म्हणतात कीं, अगदीं सहज पण थोडक्यांत खुणेप्रमाणें मी हें सांगितलें.
owis.englishMeaning: When one has acquired such pervasiveness then, only should one come back to *samsar. ramdas says, "Then on account of this spontaneous `speech', there is that thoughtless swarup." *(maharaj be out of the circle of ignorance and then enter it again with understanding) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Shreshtha Antaratma Nirupan (A Discourse on the Superior Antaratma)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मुळापासून सैरावैरा । अवघा पंचीकर्ण पसारा । त्यांत साक्षत्वाचा दोरा । तोहि तत्त्वरुप ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या दृश्य विश्वामध्यें पंचभूतांच्या मिश्रणांतून झालेला भरमसाट पसारा दिसतो. त्याचे मूळ मूळमायेमध्यें आहे. पण या सार्‍या पसार्‍यांत साक्षीपणानें राहणार्‍या अंतरात्म्याचा अखंड तंतू आहे. अर्थात् अंतरात्मादेखील तत्वांपैकी एक आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: From the root (ie. prakruti/purush) there has come this helter-skelter of `many' things. The mixing together of the five great elements has created these gross forms and this scattered expansion (ie. all this is due to objectification). And within these gross forms there is this connection of witnessing. Yet at the same time, it is that atma Himself who has become these gross elemental forms. (Within the gross world there is that witnessing antar-atma. But He cannot be found because it is He only who has also become the many gross objects. If He gives up this objectification then, naturally He will know Himself)

owis.original: दुरस्ता दाटल्या फौजा । उंच सिंहासनीं राजा । याचा विचार समजा । अंतर्यामी ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा राजा उंच सिंहासनावर बसतो. त्याच्या दोन्ही बाजूंना सैन्य दाटून उभे असते. त्याचप्रमाणें या जगांत आढळणारी तत्वें सैन्यासारखीं आहेत. त्यांच्यांतील साक्षी आत्मा राजासारखा आहे. याचा विचार मनांत समजून घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Along both sides of this `way', two armies are amassed and the King is sitting on His high throne. Therefore understand that thoughtlessness within this `speech' (ie. that thoughtless Self is the base of this thought `I am' and this is the base of the `many' thoughts). (The gross objects of the senses are the kauravas and the five great elements are the pandavas; and the King is krishna. On your path to understanding, there is this war between objectification and the dissolution of thought. krishna is with you if you choose the `way' of paramarth)

owis.original: देहमात्र अस्थिमांशाचें । तैसेंचि जाणावें नृपतीचें । मुळापासून सृष्टीचें । तत्त्वरुप ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सैनिकांचादेह जसा हाडामाांसाचा असतो तसाच राजाचा देह देखील हाडामांसाचाच असतो. त्याचप्रमाणें पंचभूतात्मक जगत् आणि त्याचा साक्षी अंतरात्मा दोन्ही तत्वरुपच आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as one knows this body of only flesh and bone, so too, one can also know this `all' body of that great King. For it is from this root of mula maya that the created world of the gross elements have come (ie. both this `all' body and the gross body have this one thing in common; they are both within this effortless knowing; therefore understand this knowing and return to your source).

owis.original: रायाचे सत्तेनें चालतें । परन्तु अवघीं पंचभूतें । मुळीं आधिक जाणिवेचे तें । अधिष्ठान आहे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राजाच्या सत्तेनें सैन्य चालतें. परंतु राजा व सैन्य दोन्ही पंचभूतात्मकच असतात. फरक इतकाच कीं राजाच्या ठिकाणीं सत्तेचे अधिष्ठान अधिक असते. अंतरात्म्याच्या ठिकाणीं जाणिवेचें अधिष्ठान अधिक असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this power of that King, the gross world functions. Yet within these gross objects (ie. kauravas) there are the five great elements (ie. pandavas). And at the root, there is this effortless knowing and this is the base for both (ie. the power of the King). (The gross objects have arisen out of the five great elements mixing together. If you give up these objects and give up this process of objectification then, you can return to your root at the beginning of creation where there is only space and wind ie. the two eldest pandavas or purush/prakruti. Then just one moving form is known by Him. He is the antar-atma or purush and He can be called space)

owis.original: विवेकें बहुत पैसावले । म्हणौन अवतारी बोलिले । मनु चक्रवती जाले । येणेंचि न्यायें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी देह नसून आत्मा आहे. " या विवेकानें जें अति विशाल झालें त्यांना अवतारी पुरुष म्हणतात. याच न्यायानें मनु चक्रवर्ति झालें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to vivek, this knowing is made to grow and the one who knows this `speech' gets called an *avatar. And then, by means of thoughtlessness, man becomes that great King (ie. Reality). (First due to the vivek of atma/non-atma, the thoughts of this gross world are abandoned; for all this is non-atma and gets destroyed every moment. And when that knowing atma is come upon then, there should be the vivek of essence/non- essence and that thoughtless essence should be accepted) *(maharaj- `avatar means to come down' ie. mula maya, He has left His Reality)

owis.original: जेथें उदंड जाणीव । तेचि तितुके सदेव । थोडे जाणीवेनें नर्देव । होती लोक ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या ठिकाणीं अतिविशाल जाणीव असते, तो तितका भाग्यवान असतो. ज्याच्या ठिकाणीं अल्प जाणीव असते तो दुर्दैवी असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In mula maya there is that vast paramatma (ie. thoughtless) and this knowing (ie. `speech'). By this knowing guna, one becomes the very fortunate (lit. with God). But if there is only a little knowing (ie. knowledge and ignorance/rajo guna), then there is the world of the very unfortunate (lit. without God). (Therefore we only have to expand this knowing that is already with us, to be with God/Self)

owis.original: व्याप आटोप करिती । धके चपेटे सोसिती । तेणें प्राणी सदेव होती । देखतदेखतां ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीं माणसें व्याप वाढवतात, खटातोप करतात, जीवनांतील धक्के व भार सोसतात तीं माणसें थोड्याच अवधींत भाग्यवान बनतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If you are continuously employed in expanding this pervasiveness and are prepared to suffer the slaps and blows (ie. let whatever comes, come; what has that got to do with me) then, within the prana and before your very eyes, you become most fortunate (with God).

owis.original: ऐसें हें आतां वर्ततें । मूर्ख लोकांस कळेना तें । विवेकी मनुष्य समजतें । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मानवी जीवनांत आज देखील असेंच आहे. पण मूर्ख लोकांना तें कळत नाहीं. जो विवेकी आहे त्याला मात्र हें सगळें समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that thoughtless paramatma will exist in the now (ie. no thoughts of the past or the future, just being). However when that One is a fool then, he does not understand this `all' world (`now'). But the viveki understands and He knows that this man is this `all thing' (He does not see a fool, He sees Himself only). (Note: When maharaj was once asked why he took all this trouble, at his age, to go to France, America etc. He said, "Because I see myself in trouble")

owis.original: थोर लाहान बुद्धीपासी । सगट कळेना लोकांसी । आधीं उमजलें तयासी । थोर म्हणती ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांतील खरा थोरपणा आणि लहानपणा, माणसाच्या विवेक शक्तीमध्येंच असतो. पण सामान्य लोकांना हें कळत नाहीं. जो आधी जन्मास येतो त्यास लोक थोर म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The great and small are with your own buddhi (who you choose to be is up to you). But this whole lumped together world of many forms does not understand this world of the `all' and so they say, "We have to respect our elders, for they were born before us."

owis.original: वयें धाकुटा नृपती । वृद्ध तयास नमस्कार करिती । विचित्र विवेकाची गती । कळली पाहिजे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राजा वयानें लहान असला तरी वृद्ध माणसें त्यास नमस्कार करतात. विवेकशक्ति कशी विचित्रपणें काम करते हें कळणें अवश्य आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Still, they do not think that, even though a king may be young in age, still the old bow down before him. This wondrous state of vivek is like this also and should be understood (ie. age is not relevant `here' or `there'. The one with understanding ie. the one with vivek, is to be respected).

owis.original: सामान्य लोकांचे ज्ञान । तो अवघाच अनुमान । दीक्षादंडकाचें लक्षण । येणेंचि पाडे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सामान्य लोकांचें ज्ञान हें सगळें अनुमानावर आधारलेलें असते. संप्रदयदीक्षा आणि लोकपरंपरा दोन्ही अनुमानावरच चालतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that paramatma has knowledge of only this gross world then, there is only conjecture and concepts. And such attention brings only traditional beliefs and custo- mary practices (like being told to respect your elders). But all these traditional beliefs get knocked down by thoughtlessness.1

owis.original: नव्हें कोणास म्हणावें । सामान्यास काये ठावें । कोणकोणास म्हणावें । किती म्हणोनी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हें खरें नाहीं. हें किती लोकांना सांगायचें?  सामान्य जनतेला त्यांतील फारसे कळत नाहीं. आणि सामान्य लोकांचीच संख्या जास्त असल्यानें कोणाकोणाला सांगत बसायचे त्याला अंतच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: If nothing is said to these people then, how can they ever understand that place of the pure knowledge? Therefore should something not be said to them?

owis.original: धाकुटा भाग्यास चढला । तरी तुछ्य करिती तयाला । याकारणें सलगीच्या लोकांला । दुरी धरावें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्यापेक्षां वयानें लहान माणूस जर भाग्यास चढला तर लोक त्याला तुच्छ लेखतात. त्याला महत्व देतच नाहींत. म्हणून आपल्या सलगी करणार्‍या व सलगी असणार्‍या लोकांना दूर ठेवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: But whoever says something to them will get treated with contempt. It is just like when someone young, climbs out of there lowly condition and attains a higher post; others want to pull him down. So, by means of this `speech', this world full of so much conjecture should be held far away (ie. it is better for you to forget everything, say nothing and just be with your understanding `I am He').

owis.original: नेमस्त कळेना वचन । नेमस्त नये राजकारण । उगेचि धरिती थोरपण । मूर्खपणें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बोललेल्या शब्दांचा निश्र्चित अर्थ ज्यांना कळत नाहीं, ज्यांना निश्र्चितपणें राजकारण करतां येत नाहीं, असें कांहीं लोक मूर्खपणानें उगीच मोठेपणा मिरवतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The limited jiva cannot understand this divine `speech' because the limited jiva cannot make raja-karana and due its foolishness, it will hold on tightly to its own greatness.

owis.original: नेमस्त कांहींच कळेना । नेमस्त कोणीच मानीना । आधीं उपजलें त्या थोरपणा । कोण पुसे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाला निश्र्चितपणें कांहींच कळत नाहीं,ज्याला खरें कोणी मानीत नाहीं, असा माणूस केवळ आधीं जन्मला म्हणून वडील बनतो. त्या वडिलपणााला कोणी विचारत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But if this limited jiva cannot understand this `thing' even and if this limited jiva has no respect for the One within everyone then, who will wipe their own greatness away and be That which, in the beginning, created all this (ie. the truly wise and eldest). Therefore these things have to be said?

owis.original: ऐसे बोलती त्यांस नाहीं । शाहाणपण ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वयानें लहान पण ज्ञानी असलेल्यानें कांहीं सांगितलें तर वृद्ध लोक म्हणतात " आतां मोठ्यांचे वडिलपण उरलें नाहीं. लहानांनी लहानपण सोडलें आहे. " असें जें बोलतात त्यांच्याजवळ शहाणपण नसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: The `eldest' (ie. atma) is not this elderliness the world knows of; the *`youngest' (ie. atma) is not this youthfulness of a body (ie. He has nothing to do with these bodily states). But the people do not know how to `speak' with such wisdom. *(maharaj- I am the youngest here, that you do not understand that)

owis.original: गुणेविण वडिलपण । हें तो आवघेंच अप्रमाण । त्याची प्रचीत प्रमाण । थोरपणीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गुणांवांचून वडिलपण येतें हें समजणें खोटे आहे. गुणांवांचून थोरपण असूं शकत नाहीं असा अनुभव येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is only elderliness in years and not that pure sattwa guna then, that thou- ghtless paramatma will be full of conjecture and lack any power (ie. then there is just an elderly man or woman). Within the greatness of that atma there is this experience `I am' and that power is with Him.

owis.original: तथापि वडिलांस मानावें । वडिलें वडिलपण जाणावें । नेणतां पुढें कष्टावें । थोरपणीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जरी हें खरें असलें तरी वयानें मोठे असणार्‍यांना मान द्यावा. परंतु मोठ्यांनीसिद्धा आपले वडिलपण खरें नाहीं हें ओळखून वागावें. असें वागलें नाहीं तर म्हातारपणीं त्रास होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Nevertheless, respect should be given to the elderly but the elderly should know this `elderliness' (ie. understand by being the atma). If you do not know this then ahead you will be made to suffer due to your so-called greatness (ie. you may or may not be respected for being older but the troubles of old age are many).

owis.original: तस्मात वडिल अंतरात्मा । जेथें चेतला तेथें महिमा । हें तो प्रगटचि आहे आम्हा । शब्द नाहीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हें सगळें सांगण्याचा अर्थ असा कीं, अंतरात्मा खरा वडील आहे. तो ज्याच्या अंतःकरणांत जागा झाला तेथें मोठेपणा येतो. ही गोष्ट उघड आहे. ती सांगण्यामुळें माझ्याकडे दोष नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore know that the `elder' is the antar-atma. If that has been awaked `here' then, there can be the greatness of `there'. But if that thoughtless paramatma becomes manifest then, there will only be this respect that gets shown to those who are older than us, but this `I am' will not be known.

owis.original: याकारणें कोणीयेकें । शाहाणपण सिकावें विवेकें । विवेक न सिकतां तुकें । लुटोन जाती ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून माणसानें विवेकाच्या बळावर शहाणपण शिकावें. जो माणूस विवेक करण्यास शिकत नाहीं त्याला लोकांत कांहीं महत्व उरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this `I am', the One who is within everyone can be understood. And this wisdom should be acquired through vivek. If this vivek is not learnt, then your importance will decrease and finally disappear (due to old age).

owis.original: तुक तुटलें म्हणिजे गेलें । जन्मा येऊन काये केलें । बळेंचि सांदीस घातलें । आपणासी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाची लोकांत कांहीं किंमत उरत नाहीं, त्याचा जन्म फुकट गेला. असा माणूस आपणहून आपणास हिन दशा प्राप्त करुन घेतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If your importance gets lost then, tell me, what have you achieved by taking this birth? All you have done is beat yourself into a hole.

owis.original: सगट बायेका सिव्या देती । सांदीस पडिला ऐसें म्हणती । मूर्खपणाची प्राप्ती । ठाकून आली ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळ्या स्त्रियासुद्धा त्याला नांवें ठेवूं लागतात. तो अशगळींत जाऊन पडला असें म्हणतात. अशा रीतीनें मूर्खपणा पदरांत पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then those who are supposed to take care of you and respect you will speak abusively to you and when you have fallen in this hole they will say, "Ah look! Here comes the old fool."

owis.original: ऐसें कोणीयेकें न करावें । सर्व सार्थकचि करावें । कळेना तरी विवरावें । ग्रंथांतरी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसानें असें करुं नये. आपल्या जीवनाचे सर्व प्रकारें सार्थक करुन घ्यावें. तें कळत नसेल तर ग्रंथांचा अभ्यास करुन त्यांतून शिकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this, that One who is within everyone should not do; this `all' and the true meaning of life (ie. to know your Self, the One) should be gained. If these have not been understood then, there should now be that investigation that is within these composition of words/scripture (understand the meaning these words are trying to convey; That from where words come back).

owis.original: शाहाण्यास कोणीतरी बाहाती । मूर्खास लोक दवडून देती । जीवास आवडे संपत्ति । तरी शाहाणे व्हावें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शहाण्या माणसाला लोक आपणहून बोलावतात. मूर्खला लोक बाजूस सारतात. ज्याला संपत्ति आवडत असेल व हवी असेल त्यानें शहाणें बनावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Everyone invites the wise but the whole world chases away the fool. If the jiva has the desire for real wealth, then, there should be this wisdom.

owis.original: आहो या शाहाणपणाकारणें । बहुतांचे कष्ट करणें । परंतु शाहाणपण शिकणें । हें उत्तमोत्तम ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अहो, हें शहाणपण शिकण्यासाठीं पुष्कळांचे कष्ट करावें लागतात, हें खरें परंतु कष्ट करुन शहाणपण शिकावें. कारण त्यासारखी उत्तमांत उत्तम दुसरी गोष्ट नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: My dear! The `all' has to suffer and endure a lot to gain this wise `speech' but by learning such wisdom, thoughtlessness can be understood and you will become the `greatest of the great'. (ranjit maharaj- If He [siddharameshwar maharaj] had not been there then I would still be an insect in the shit. He made me into the `greatest of the great')

owis.original: जों बहुतांस मानला । तो जाणावा शाहाणा जाला । जनीं शाहाण्या मनुष्याला । काये उणें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो पुष्कळ लोकांना मान्य होतो, तो शहाणा झाला असें समजावें. शहाण्या माणसाला जगांत काहींच कमी पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush respects this `all' then, one should know that wisdom has come. If such wisdom comes to a person in this world then, they will lack for nothing?

owis.original: आपलें हित न करी लोकिकीं । तो जाणावा आत्मघातकी । या मूर्खायेवढा पातकी । आणिक नाहीं ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो माणूस लोकांमध्यें आपलें हित करुन घेत नाहीं. तो आत्मघातकी समजावा. त्या मूर्खाइतका पातकी दुसरा कोणी नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But if one stays in the world and does not care for their own welfare then, that purush should be considered as one who has committed suicide; for he is a killer of His Self. When one commits such great injustice to one's own Self then, there is none more foolish.

owis.original: आपण संसारीं कष्टलो । लोकांकरवीं रागेजोन घेतो । जनामध्यें शाहाणा तो । ऐसें न करी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूर्ख माणूस संसारांत कष्ट करतो, लोकांकडून बोलणीं खातो, लोकांत जो शहाणा असतो, तो असें करीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That paramatma puts Its own Self in the troubles and toils of samsar and that paramatma accepts the anger and scorn of this world. But the wise never do that in this world.

owis.original: साधकां सिकविलें स्वभावें । मानेल तरी सुखें घ्यावें । मानेना तरी सांडावें । येकिकडे ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साधकानें कसें वागावें तें मी सहज येथें सांगितलें. तें जर मनास पटलें तर स्विकारावें अन्यथा सोडून द्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: If the sadhak lets this spontaneous `all' teach him and if he values this then, there will be happiness. But if this is not valued then, he can leave aside this company of that One.

owis.original: तुम्ही श्रोते परम दक्ष । अलक्षास लावितां लक्ष । हें तों सामान्य प्रत्यक्ष । जाणतसा ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तुम्ही श्रोते फार तत्पर आहात. तुम्ही अलक्षावर लक्ष लावता. परमात्मस्वरुपाचें ध्यान करतां, मग मी सांगितलें तें तर अगदी सामान्य आहे, दृश्यामधील आहे, हें तुम्ही ओळखता.
owis.englishMeaning: If you are a supremely alert listener then, you can learn to concentrate on that which cannot be concentrated on. Then that thoughtless paramatma will know that these sensory perceptions (ie. the helter-skelter of `many' things) are truly that pure knowledge of brahman. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Shashwat Brahma Nirupan (A Discourse on the Eternal Brahman)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: पृथ्वीपासून जालीं झाडें । झाडापासून होती लांकडें । लांकडें भस्मोन पुढें । पृथ्वीच होये ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीपासून झाडें होतात. झाडांपासून लाकडें होतात. लाकडें जळून त्याची राख होतें. राख वा माती म्हणजे पृथ्वीच होय.
owis.englishMeaning: From this element earth, trees have appeared; and from the trees, wood appeared (and from the wood a chair, a door etc. appeared. All this is the objectification of knowledge). But when the wood gets burnt to ashes then, there is only this great element earth.

owis.original: पृथ्वीपासून वेल होती । नाना जिनस फापावती । वाळोन कुजोन मागुती । पृथ्वीच होये ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीपासून वेल होतात. त्यांच्यावर पानें, फुलें, फळें वगैरे नाना पदार्थ फोफावतात. ते वाळतात व कुजतात अखेर त्यांची पृथ्वीच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: From this element earth, there has come this creeper called the individual mind and then, `many' objects are spread abundantly all over. But they become dry or rot and again there is only this earth (individuality is this earth element and from out of this earth element `many' imagined things appear and disappear. All these thingsappear and disappear as long as you hold a body. But where are these when you sleep?).

owis.original: नानाा धान्यांचीं नाना अन्नें । मनुष्यें करिती भोजनें । नाना विष्ठा नाना वमनें । पृथ्वीच होये ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या धान्यांची निरनिराळीं अन्नें होतात, माणसें तीं खतात. त्या अन्नाची अखेर विष्ठा होते, वमने होतात म्हणजे अखेर मातीच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' grains and the `many' foods and after the human beings have eaten and enjoyed these `many' things then, there are the `many' excretes and the `many' vomits and after there is only this earth.

owis.original: नाना पक्षादिकीं भक्षिलें । तरीं पुढें तैसेंचि जालें । वाळोन भस्म होऊन गेलें । पुन्हा पृथ्वी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या पक्ष्यांनी व पशूंनी धान्य भक्षण केलें तरी त्याची नंतर विष्ठाच होते. ती वाळून भूगा झाला म्हणजे मातीच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' birds etc. eat the seeds and then later these become excrement. This dries up and becomes dust and again there is this earth (everything returns to dust; everything must return from where it came).2

owis.original: मनुष्यें मरतां ऐका । क्रिमि भस्म कां मृत्तिका । ऐशा काया पडती अनेका । पुढें पृथ्वी ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस मेला कीं त्याला जाळतात किंवा मातींत पुरतात किंवा कृमींना खायला देतात. अशी कितीतरी मानवी शरीरें मरतात. त्या सर्वांची अखेर मातीच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore listen to this `I am'. Otherwise the human being dies and the body is either eaten by worms or burnt to ashes. For when these bodies of these numerous different shapes fall, then, again there is this earth (within this knowledge of `I am' there is this world of `many' people and in this knowledge they get born and die. Still the individual jiva says, "I am seeing all this". But when he dies and knowledge goes off then, where is its imagined world and this imagined, Mr. so and so?).

owis.original: नाना तृण पदार्थ कुजती । पुढें त्याची होये माती । नाना किडे मरोन जाती । पुढें पृथ्वी ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक वनस्पती, गवत कुजतें शेवटी त्याची मातीच होते. कितीतरी किडे मरुन जातात व शेवटी त्यांची मातीच बनते.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to these `many' worthless things, this object of the `all' has been lost and then there is nothing but the dust of `many' things. And then the `many' *small creatures die and disappear and afterwards there is this earth (every day we watch this drama unfold before our eyes. We see innumerable creatures live and die and still there is this earth ie. as long as we are there there will be our objective ever-changing world. Yet seeing the impermanence of all this, still we live as if immortal, because our base is that immortal Self). *(We are the small creatures swami ramdas speaks of)

owis.original: पदार्थ दाटले अपार । किती सांगावा विस्तार । पृथ्वीवांचून थार । कोणास आहे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत अगणिक पदार्थ भरलेले आहेत. त्यांचा सगळा विस्तार सांगणें शक्य नाहीं. पण त्या सर्वांना अखेर पृथ्वीचाच आधार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This object of knowledge (that the `many' things appear within) is the pervasiveness of that limitless and eternal Self. Therefore this expansion of the `many' should return to that Self. Otherwise, other than this earth, what support will there be for these `many' objects? (Though being that limitless eternal Self, if we take ourselves to be a body then, our only support is this elemental world)

owis.original: झाड पाले आणि तृण । पशु भक्षितां होतें सेण । खात मूत भस्म मिळोन । पुन्हा पृथ्वी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पशु झाडपाला, गवत वगैरे खातात, खाल्ल्यावर त्याचे शेण बनते. खत, मूत, राख यांची अखेर मातीच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: The trees, leaves and grass get eaten by animals and they produce dung; this excre- ment, urine and dust mix together and again there is this earth (without this dirt and water how would the seed grow? maharaj- everything comes from dirt and you say, "Such a lovely basmati rice." But next morning when you go to the toilet?) body, come from dust, exist as dust and in the end are destroyed and become dust. How much more needs to be told? All beasts and birds, insects, ants, and even man are only dust. From dust have come grains and from them comes blood and from that, semen is created and from semen comes the creation of man. This dust is the "lineage of mankind," but within it there is the original purusha. And when that is established then how can there be this "story" made by knowledge? This knowledge is only dust.

owis.original: उत्पत्तिस्थितिसंव्हारतें । तें तें पुथ्वीस मिळोन जातें । जितुकें होतें आणि जातें । पुन्हा पृथ्वी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें कांहीं निर्माण होते तें कांहीं काल टिकते आणि अखेर नाश पावतें, त्याची अखेर मातीच होते. जें जें होतें व जातें त्याची शेवटी माती बनतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this creation, maintenance and destruction (ie. the imagining, knowing and not knowing of the three gunas), that Reality has been mixed with this great earth element and then, within the destructible, that indestructible Self cannot be found. Then whatever comes, that much goes and again there is this earth.

owis.original: नाना बीजांचिया रासी । विरढोन लागती गगनासी । पुढें सेवटीं पृथ्वीसी । मिळोन जाती ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक बीजांच्या राशी पेरल्यावर उगवतात, वाढत वाढतजणूंआकाशाला भिडतात पण शेवटी त्या मातींत मिसळून जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: Out of the piles of `many' seeds some take root and reach for the sky; but in the end, they merge is this earth and disappear (we get born, have `many' dreams but in the end this body dies and returns to dust).

owis.original: लोक नाना धातु पुरिती ॥ बहुतां दिवसां होये माती । सुवर्णपाषाणाची गती । तैसीच आहे॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळे धातु जमिनींत पुरुन ठेवतात. पुष्कळ काळ झाल्यावर त्यांची मातीच होते. सोनें व पाषाण यांची तीच गत होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this world filled up with these `many' dhatu then, this fortunate time of the `all' is turned to dust. Then this gold and these stones are regarded as the same (this gold is `I am' or knowing and the stones are these `many' bodies. But these bodies are as dead as a stone without this `I am')

owis.original: मातीचें होतें सुवर्ण । आणी मृत्तिकेचे होती पाषाण । माहा अग्निसंगें भस्मोन । पृथ्वीच होये ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मातीचें सोनें बनतें. मातीचाच पाषाण बनतो. मोठ्या अग्नीनें पाषाणाची राख होतें. म्हणजे अखेर त्याची मातीच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this gold becomes dust and these stones become dust and due to its company with the great fire element, this `all' body gets burnt and becomes this earth (the fire element brings increasing objectification; something other than myself is known. Then there is the water element and finally a gross form is seen on account of the earth element. Then this `all' body appears as "Mr. so and so" and he sees `many' things come and go).

owis.original: सुवर्णाचें जर होतें । जर सेवटीं कुजोन जातें । रस होऊन वितुळतें । पुन्हा पृथ्वी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सोन्यापासून जर तयार करतात. जर शेवटीं कुजून जाते. ती वितळून त्याचा रस होतो. परंतु पुन्हा मातीच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' has been affected by the fever of "I am a body" that, in the end, rots and disappears. This inner spirit (`I am') has become a body that dissipates and then 37 constituents that make up the body. once more there is this earth (taking yourself to be a body, we see `many' bodies and there is the endless cycle of wakefulness and sleep and birth and death).

owis.original: पृथ्वीपासून धातु निपजती । अग्निसंगें रस होती । तया रसाची होये जगती । कठीणरुपें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीपासून धातु होतात. अग्नीनें त्यांचा रस होतो. त्या रसाचा पुनः कठीण पदार्थ होतो. तो पृथ्वीच होय.
owis.englishMeaning: From this earth, seven dhatus spring up. Then on account of this fire element, a gross body has been created. Due to your company with this fire element, that inner spirit can be perceived and also, on account of this hardened form of this inner spirit (`I am'), there is that Reality appearing in this world. (This great fire element, like all the elements, plays two roles. It can either assist in objectification ie. creation or it can assist in its dissolution. When on account of ignorance and objectification this `I am' appears as the gross elements then, a gross body and world is seen. And when on account of vivek, there is only the knowingness of this fire element then, the process is reversed and this `I am' will once again shine )

owis.original: नाना जळासी गंधी सुटे । तेथें पृथ्वीचें रुप प्रगटे । दिवसेंदिवस जळ आटे । पुढें पृथ्वी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळवेळां पाण्याला वास येतो. वास किंवा गंध हा पृथ्वीचा गुण आहे. म्हणून ज्या पाण्याला वास येतो त्यांत पृथ्वीचा अंश आहे. पाणी हळुहळु आटुन शेवटी पृथ्वीच उरते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' smells that come from the element water then, that brahman `there' has manifested as this earth form. And this drying up of the water element is taking place day after day and afterwards there is this earth (this process of objectification is continually taking place. One object appears and this must be forgotten for the next to appear. This we call our waking state or the earth). (Due to this earth element `many' names and forms appear; this is the work of our impure buddhi. Still this is not samsar. It is afterwards when the jiva continually uses these objects and creates its own concepts upon these objects that body consciousness is firmly established)5

owis.original: पत्रें पुष्पें फळें येती । नाना जीव खाऊन जाती । ते जीव मरतां जगती । नेमस्त होये ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीवर अनेक पानें, फुलें, फळें येतात. अनेक प्राणी ते खातात. ते प्राणी मेल्यावर अखेर त्यांची मातीच बनते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that One appears as these leaves, flowers and fruits of this tree of creation;6 and the jiva sits upon this and eats its `many' fruits and then goes away again. If that Reality remains as a jiva then, it will die in this world and again there will be the birth of a limited form.

owis.original: जितुका कांहीं जाला आकार । तितुक्यास पृथ्वीचा आधार । होती जाती प्राणीमात्र । सेवट पृथ्वी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जी जी वस्तु आकार धारण करतें, त्या त्या वस्तुला पृथ्वीचाच आधार असतो. पुष्कळ प्राणी जन्माला येतात व मरतात या सर्वांचा शेवट अखेर पृथ्वीमधें होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: However much of this `thing' takes a gross shape, that much has the support of this earth (from a part of this one moving `thing' comes the `many' individual forms and things due to a gross buddhi). Then that One comes and goes in the prana and in the end, there is this earth.7

owis.original: हें किती म्हणौन सांगावें । विवेकें अवघेंचि जाणावें । खांजणीभजणीचें समजावें । मूळ तैसें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हें जितकें सांगावें तितकें कमीच आहे. आपण विवेकानें सगळें समजून घ्यावें. विश्वाच्या उभारणीचें व संहारणीचें मूळ यांत आहें हें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' therefore should return to that thoughtless swarup (I do not exist). Every thing should be known by vivek, and in this way, the formation of this gross creation and its destruction will be understood. (Note: ahead is the dissolution by vivek)

owis.original: आप आळोन पृथ्वी जाली । पुन्हां आपींच विराली । अग्नियोगें भस्म जाली । म्हणोनियां ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाणी आटून पृथ्वी झाली. पण पुढें अग्नीनें जळून भस्म झाली. कीं ती पुन्हा पाण्यांत विरुन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: When the great waters are dried with the help of the shining sun (ie. fire of knowing) then, this earth element appears and forms are created. And when this is merged again into these waters then, the reverse process begins (returning to the formless).

owis.original: आप जालें तेजापासूनी । पुढें तेजें घेतलें सोखुनी । तें तेज जालें वायोचेनी । पुढें वायो झडपी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेजापासून आप निर्माण होते. पण पुढें तेजच त्यास शोषून घेतें. तेज वायूपासून निर्माण होतें, पुढें वायुच त्यास विझवून टाकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The water had appeared from within the fire element and ahead this gets dried up by that great fire. Reality has become this great fire on account of the wind element and afterwards this wind extinguishes that fire. (When the fire element becomes cold, the water element is formed and when the fire is hot, it rises up to become the wind element. Each of the five elements have these two properties, they can either go down and become hard or more objective or they can rise up and become soft and less objective) 7siddharameswar maharaj- As long as thought is there the visible world is there. No thought no world. Therefore the mother and father of the world or Lord brahma the creator of the world, is a thought or intellect/buddhi. When there is the establishment of a thought then the Self gets called buddhi. And when a doubt of that thought appears then the Self gets called mind. The buddhi and the mind are really of one nature but it is the buddhi that decides that the One Self is a particular thing and as soon as this is determined, the buddhi stops. This means that the understanding has become gross or objective. Once the mind has determined or decided that the Self is a particular thing then the mind, known as buddhi, does not think any further. Once the mind has become objective and does not think further or move on from within this state that the buddhi has decided upon, then even in hundreds of births, that Supreme Self remains firmly fixed as something. Nothing is there but still if the buddhi decides it is something then it actually will be there, even though it is not.

owis.original: वायो गगनीं निर्माण जाला । पुढें गगनींच विराला । ऐसें खांजणीभांजणीला । बरें पाहा ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायु आकाशापासून निर्माण होतो पण पुढें तो आकाशांतच लीन होऊन जातो. विश्वाच्या उभारणी संहारणीचा विचार अशा पद्धतीनें करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: And this wind had been created in the sky and so afterwards it disappears in the sky only. Like this is creation and destruction; therefore understand the best (thought- lessness).

owis.original: जें जें जेथें निर्माण होतें । तें तें तेथें लया जातें । येणें रितीं पंचभूतें । नाश पावती ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें ज्याच्यापासून निर्माण होतें तें तें अखेर त्याच्यामधेच लयास जातें. याच नियमानें पंचभूतांचा नाश घडून येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: For whenever mula maya is created `here' then, that Reality `there' is disappears. But if there is thoughtlessness then, these five great elements are annihilated.

owis.original: भूत म्हणिजे निर्माण जालें । पुन्हां मागुतें निमालें । पुढें शाश्वत उरलें । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भूत शब्दाचा अर्थ " जें कांहीं निर्माण झालें तें " असा आहे. म्हणून पंचभूतें नाश पावतात. त्यानंतर शाश्वतपणें जें उरतें तें परब्रह्म होय.
owis.englishMeaning: A great element means `that which has been created'; therefore it is sure to be destroyed afterwards. Still that eternal remains and that is parabrahman.

owis.original: तें परब्रह्म जों कळेना । तो जन्ममृत्य चुकेना । चत्वार खाणी जीव नाना । होणें घडे ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें परब्रह्म जोपर्यंत कळत नाहीं, तोपर्यंत जन्म-मृत्यु चुकत नाहींत. चार खाणीमध्यें अनेक जीवांच्या रुपानें जन्म घ्यावा लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush does not understand parabrahman (ie. when He identifies with His prakruti), then he cannot escape birth and death. Then as one of the `many' jiva, he will take birth in one of the four streams of birth.

owis.original: जडाचें मूळ तें चंचळ । चंचळाचें मूळ तें निश्र्चळ । निश्र्चळासी नाहीं मूळ । बरें पाहा ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जडाचें मूळ चंचळामधें आहे. आणि चंचळाचें मूळ निश्र्चळामधें आहे. पण निश्र्चळाचें मूळ आणखीं कशांत नाहीं हें नीट समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The root of the inert is the moving and the root of the moving is the still. The still has no root. Therefore understand thoughtlessness.

owis.original: पूर्वपक्ष म्हणिजे जालें । सिद्धांत म्हणिजे निमाले । पक्षातीत जें संचलें । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें निर्माण झालें तें दृश्य विश्व खरें मानणें, हा पूर्वपक्ष होय. जें निर्माण झालें तें दिसलें तरी खरें नाहीं हा सिद्धान्त पक्ष होय. या दोन्ही पक्षांच्या पलीकडे असून जें सर्वत्र भरलेलें आहें तें परब्रह्म होय.
owis.englishMeaning: The primary hypothesis is, `It has appeared' and the Great Truth/siddhant is, `It is not there'. Beyond this side where mula maya is amassed (`It has appeared'), there is that parabrahman.

owis.original: हें प्रचितीनें जाणावें । विचारें खुणेसी बाणावें । विचारेंविण सिणावें । तेंचि मूर्खपणें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रचितीनें याचे ज्ञान करुन घ्यावें. विचारानें त्याची खूण अगदीं पक्की ध्यानांत ठेवावी.विचारवांचून फुकट श्रम करणें मूर्खपणाचें असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless swarup should be known by means of this `I am' experience and then by means of thoughtlessness, the nirgun understanding should be fully accepted. But without thoughtlessness, there are pains and exhaustion and that Reality appears like a fool.

owis.original: ज्ञानी भिडेनें दडपला । निश्र्चळ परब्रह्म कैंचे त्याला । उगाच करितो गल्बला । मायेंमधें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा ज्ञानमार्गी माणूस मायेच्या भिडेला बळी पडला तर त्याला निश्चळ परब्रह्म प्राप्त होणार नाहीं. तो मायेच्या कक्षेमधें उगीच गडबड करत राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If being in knowledge you are oppressed by regard or fear (ie. being a jiva) then, how can you be that still parabrahman? For then that still and silent Self makes a lot of noise in maya.

owis.original: माया निशेष नासली । पुढें स्थिति कैसी उरली । विचक्षणें विवरिली । पाहिजे स्वयें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माया संपूर्ण नाश पावली म्हणजे मग अवस्था उरत नाहीं. ही गोष्ट चतुर माणसानें स्वतः विचारानें समजून घ्यावी.
owis.englishMeaning: But after when there is the complete dissolution of maya, what state can remain? Therefore that natural swarup should be investigated through wise discernment.

owis.original: निशेष मायेचें निर्शन । होतां आत्मनिवेदन । वाच्यांश नाहीं विज्ञान । कैसें जाणावें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माया निःशेष निरास पावली कीं खरें आत्मनिवेदन घडते. ज्या ठिकाणीं शब्द पोचूं शकत नाहीं त्या विज्ञानाचे ज्ञान स्वानुभवावांचून घडणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When maya gets completely dissolved then, that is the `surrender to the atma'. However if there is no `word' meaning (ie. sagun hypothesis) then, how can vignyan be understood? (ie. there is the great statement, You are That. First understand who you are. You are knowledge. This is the `word' meaning of this statement. And only when this knowledge goes off, can the implied meaning of this statement be understood )

owis.original: लोकांचे बोली जो लागला । तो अनुमानेंच बुडाला । याकारणें प्रत्ययाला । पाहिलेंच पाहावें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोक बोलतात त्याच्या नादीं जो लागतो तो अनुमानाच्या चंचळपणानें बुडतो किंवा वाया जातो म्हणून साधकानें पुनः पुनः अनुभवाच्या ज्ञानाकडे वळावे.
owis.englishMeaning: If that purush gets affected by the talk of this world then, He will drown in doubts and conjectures. Therefore understand that, only by means of this `speech', can that nirgun be understood (ie. the `speech' is the dissolution of the gross, the earth, the water and the fire elements. And when the nirgun is understood then, neither wind nor space remain). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Chanchal Lakshan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Attributes of the Moving)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: दोघां ऐसीं तीन चालती । अगुणी अष्टधा प्रकृती । अधोर्ध सांडून वर्तती । इंद्रफणी ऐसी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शक्तिमय प्रकृति व जाणीवमय पुरुष या उभयतांच्या मार्गदर्शनाखालीं सत्व, रज व तम हें तीन गुण चालतात. तीन गुण व पंचभूतें मिळून अष्टधा प्रकृति बनतें. दृश्य विश्व व अव्यक्त परब्रह्म एकमेकांच्या उलट असतात. दृश्य जड विश्व जदत्वामुळें कांहीं करुं शकत नाहीं. परब्रह्म निश्चळ म्हणून तें कांहीं करत नाही. म्हणून या दोघांमधें वावरणारी अष्टधा प्रकृति विश्र्वरचनेचा सगळा खेळ खेळते.
owis.englishMeaning: That One has become two (purush/prakruti) and then It functions as three (ie. gunas). Within that unmanifest nirgun (purush) there is this eight-fold prakruti (pure sattwa guna). By looking downwards/outwards this prakruti is let slip and then that One becomes manifest, just like a rainbow in the sky.

owis.original: पणतोंडें भक्षितो पणजा । मूल बापास मारी वोजा । चुकार्‍या गेला राजा । चौघां जणांचा ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व विश्वाचा राजा आहे परब्रह्म. मूळपुरुष आहे अंतरात्मा. त्याचा मुलगा सत्वगुण किंवा विष्णु. नातु रजोगुण किंवा ब्रह्मदेव. आणि पणतु महेश किंवा तमोगुण. मूळपुरुष अंतरात्मा पणजोबा आहे. अज्ञानाच्यापायीं स्वस्वरुपाचा लोप झाला. आणि इंद्रियसुख भोगण्याच्यापायीं स्वस्वरुपाकडे जाण्याची प्रवृत्ति नाहींशी झाली. यामुळें परब्ह्म हरवते. माणसाला परब्रह्म प्राप्ती होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The great grandfather, consumes His great-grandson (ie. pure knowledge destroys ignorance). But this son easily defeats his father (but if these gunas remain then, ignorance/sleep easily takes over and destroys the waking state) and then that King of these four has been completely forgotten. (King parabrahman, G. Grand father mula purush, Grandfather pure sattwa/prakruti, father raja, son tamo)

owis.original: देव देवाळयामधें लपाला । देऊळ पूजितां पावे त्याला । सृष्टिमधें ज्याला त्याला । ऐसेंचि आहे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवळांत देव आहे पण तो लपलेला आहे. देवळाची पूजा केली कीं ती देवाला पावते. जगांत प्रत्येकाच्याबाबतींत असेंच आहे. प्रत्येक पिंडांत अंतरात्मा वास करतो. परंतु त्याचे प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन कोणास करतां येत नाहीं. देहाची पूजा केली कीं ती अंतरात्म्याला पोचतें.
owis.englishMeaning: God is hidden within His temple and even if you worship this temple of `I am' still, this worship reaches that purush (for within the `I am' body that God/purush is hidden). But in this gross creation, that purush becomes just like the gross only (then both are forgotten/defeated and there is the manifestation of the gunas and this waking state of rajo guna).

owis.original: दोनी नामें येकास पडिली । लोकीं नेमस्त कल्पिलीं । विवेकें प्रत्ययें पाहिलीं । तों येकचि नाम ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रकृति व पुरुष अशी दोन नांवें लोक वापरतात. पण लोकांनींच आपल्या कल्पनेनें ती निर्माण केलीं आहेत. विचारानें आणि अनुभवानें पाहिलें तर मूळ वस्तु एकच आहे असें आढळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That One within this two has come down due to this `I am' and then in this world that clear and steady One started imagining (ie. forgetting He was the witnessing purush, He becomes the witnessed and due to latent desires and ignorance, he becomes a gross mind and body). But through vivek, that One who has become like a gutter attains Its nirgun swarup (that pure water had become like filthy gutter water due to imagination).

owis.original: नाहीं पुरुष ना वनिता । लोकीं कल्पिलें तत्त्वता । त्याचा बरा शोध घेतां । कांहींच नाही ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रकृति व पुरुष असें म्हणत असतांना स्त्री व पुरुष असा भास होतो. पण तेथें स्त्री नाहीं व पुरुषही नाहीं, ही लोकांची कल्पना आहे. ती कल्पना तपासून पाहिलीं तर मुळांत कांहींच नाहीं असें आढळते.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is no purush and prakruti then, there can be no woman and no man. These women and men of this world have been completely imagined by your buddhi. But if you search for and accept the wisdom of that paramatma then, even this `thing'/prakruti will not remain.

owis.original: स्त्री नदी पुरुष खळाळ । ऐसें बोलती सकळ । विचार पाहातां निवळ । देह नाहीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नदी ही स्त्री व ओढा हा पुरुष असें म्हणतात. पण विचार केलां तर त्यांना कांहीं स्त्री-पुरुषांचे देह नाहीत असें समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: In marathi the word for river is feminine and the word for brook is masculine. But both words come from this `speech' of `I am' and it is only due to imagination that different names are used for what is after all, only water. In the same way, if one clearly understands thoughtlessness then, there are no bodies (ie. no naming and forming and therefore no man or woman, and no subtle body, no causal body and no supra-causal body also).

owis.original: आपण आपणास कळेना । पाहों जातां आकळेना । कशास कांहींच मिळेना । उदंडपणें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी कोण " हें आपलें आपल्यालाच कळत नाहीं. तें पहायला गेले तर खरा मी आकलन होत नाहीं. अफाटपणामुळें कशाचा कशाशींच मेळ बसत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But you do not understand yourself and even if you try to see yourself still you cannot grasp this (if you remain and try to see yourself then something other will be known ie. this reflection `I am'). You may ask, "Why is it that this `thing' cannot meet that vast-ness of paramatma?"

owis.original: येकलाचि उदंड जाला । उदंडचि येकला पडिला । आपणासी आपला । गल्बला सोसवेना ॥ ८ ॥
